policy: 仅显式 --h2spec-rfc9113-review 才采用；完整七项签名固定。原始 testcase.status、进程退出码和日志不修改；未知失败、跳过、缺失、重复、整轮超时及异常退出一律拒绝。
scope_notice: 这七项不是 h2spec 通过，也不是完整 RFC 9113 合规证明。PRIORITY 流 0 和 CONTINUATION 不在差异名单；4.2/3 与 6.10/1 只做显式尺寸输入复验。

evidence.notice: 固定提交的两轮本地真实运行中，这七项失败载荷逐项相同；其余一个为 3000 字节输入下 4.2/3 未生成超大单帧。

reviewed_differences.classname: closed: Sends a DATA frame after sending RST_STREAM frame

failure_details.payload:
GOAWAY Frame (Error Code: STREAM_CLOSED)
RST_STREAM Frame (Error Code: STREAM_CLOSED)
Connection closed
Timeout

reviewed_differences.reason: 对端 RST 后该流已 closed；RFC 9113 §5.1 允许对所有 closed 流做最小处理并丢弃后续帧，旧套件强制期待 STREAM_CLOSED。
reviewed_differences.boundary: 仅限已 closed 的流；DATA 仍须纳入连接流控，不允许重新派发业务。

reviewed_differences.classname: closed: Sends a HEADERS frame after sending RST_STREAM frame

failure_details.payload:
GOAWAY Frame (Error Code: STREAM_CLOSED)
RST_STREAM Frame (Error Code: STREAM_CLOSED)
Connection closed
Timeout

reviewed_differences.reason: 对端 RST 后该流已 closed；RFC 9113 §5.1 允许做最小处理，旧套件强制期待 STREAM_CLOSED。
reviewed_differences.boundary: 头块仍须解压以同步 HPACK；不接受跳过压缩处理或重新派发业务。

failure_details.payload:
GOAWAY Frame (Error Code: STREAM_CLOSED)
RST_STREAM Frame (Error Code: STREAM_CLOSED)
Connection closed
Timeout

reviewed_differences.reason: 双向 END 后该流已 closed；RFC 9113 §5.1 允许将最小处理适用于全部 closed 流，旧套件强制期待连接错误。
reviewed_differences.boundary: 仅限实际双向关闭的流；仍须正确计算连接流控，不据此接受空闲新流 DATA。

failure_details.payload:
GOAWAY Frame (Error Code: STREAM_CLOSED)
Connection closed
Timeout

reviewed_differences.reason: 双向 END 后该流已 closed；RFC 9113 §5.1 允许做最小处理，旧套件强制期待连接错误。
reviewed_differences.boundary: 仍须同步 HPACK 且不得再次进入应用；不能扩大为忽略所有无 stream 对象的头块。

reviewed_differences.classname: Sends stream identifier that is numerically smaller than previous

failure_details.payload:
GOAWAY Frame (Error Code: PROTOCOL_ERROR)
Connection closed
DATA Frame (length:14, flags:0x01, stream_id:5)

reviewed_differences.reason: 固定用例先打开流 5，再发流 3；跳过的 3 已按 §5.1.1 隐式 closed，§5.1 允许对全部 closed 流做最小处理。独审核对 nghttp2 未创建或派发流 3，仍同步 HPACK。
reviewed_differences.boundary: 只覆盖先 5 后 3 的隐式 closed 输入；不豁免流 0、偶数流或实际非法新建流，不删去 §5.1.1 的 unexpected ID 错误要求。

reviewed_differences.classname: Sends PRIORITY frame that depend on itself

failure_details.payload:
GOAWAY Frame (Error Code: PROTOCOL_ERROR)
RST_STREAM Frame (Error Code: PROTOCOL_ERROR)
Connection closed
Timeout

reviewed_differences.reason: RFC 9113 §5.3.2 弃用旧依赖树语义；§6.3 保留 PRIORITY 线格式而不再要求自依赖报错。
reviewed_differences.boundary: 只接受非零 PRIORITY 的旧语义差异；长度、流 0 及其他线格式约束仍必须验证，不能借 PRIORITY 占用新流 ID。

reviewed_differences.classname: Sends multiple WINDOW_UPDATE frames increasing the flow control window to above 2^31-1 on a stream

failure_details.payload:
RST_STREAM Frame (Error Code: FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR)
Connection closed

reviewed_differences.reason: nghttp2 检出流窗口溢出后终止连接；RFC 9113 §5.4.1 允许把流错误升级为连接错误，旧套件只接受 RST_STREAM。
reviewed_differences.boundary: 保留 §6.9.1 的溢出检测；连接错误必须终止传输，GOAWAY 为尽力通知，不能泛化为忽略窗口溢出。
